capabilities: Print note properties as a header in the built-in PDF export
Hide chosen property names and order the remaining fields
Switch between table and compact header layouts
Preview the printable header in reading view
Assign layout rules per folder with Pro
extras: Free features cover the full header, both layouts, hide list and ordering; Pro adds per-folder layout rules and needs a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of $15 once or $5 a month, which unlocks Pro in all NoteMods plugins. Desktop Obsidian 1.13.4+ only; mobile PDF export is not supported. The plugin opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat, and makes no network requests until GitHub sign-in.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a header while Obsidian renders the document.
problem: Exported PDFs drop a note's frontmatter, so authors, dates, statuses and tags have to be copied into the body or kept in a separate export note.

relations.evidence: Choose Advanced PDF Export for those document controls. Choose this plugin for a labeled property header
Complete PDF Export also supports property cards through its own export workflow.

summary: Adds a labeled header of a note's properties to Obsidian's built-in PDF export, with a hide list, property ordering and table or compact layouts.
